title: Commercial filters, export, and search reconciliation
summary: Three logical Requirements retain source provenance while human reconciliation progresses across local and shared behavior.

input_assessment.summary: The main story, two supporting artifacts, and repository observations establish three capabilities with unresolved shared behavior.

exploration.stop_reason: The bounded result surface and source artifacts establish the local and cross-requirement scope.
limitations: Pagination and accent sensitivity remain human decisions.

sources.label: US 36134 story
sources.original_text: Provide advanced filters for the commercial result.

sources.label: US 36134 acceptance notes
sources.original_text: The filter experience must preserve the selected commercial structure and its visible result.

sources.label: US 36134 screenshot annotation
sources.original_text: Screenshot annotation: the filter panel shows region, segment, and status controls.

sources.label: US 36174 story
sources.original_text: Export the current commercial result to Excel.

sources.label: US 36198 story
sources.original_text: Search the commercial result using free text.

needs.title: Filter commercial results
needs.statement: A user filters commercial results by the requested structure.
acceptance_signals: The result reflects the selected filters

needs.title: Preserve filter panel behavior
needs.statement: The filter panel exposes the documented commercial controls.

needs.title: Export the current result
needs.statement: A user exports the current commercial result to Excel.
preconditions: A result has been filtered or searched
acceptance_signals: The Excel file represents the current result
negative_signals: The export does not silently use a different result

needs.title: Search commercial results
needs.statement: A user searches commercial results with free text.

evidence.detail: The US 36134 story requests advanced filtering of the commercial result.
The supporting acceptance notes and screenshot annotation describe the visible filter surface.
The US 36174 story requests an Excel representation of the current commercial result.
The US 36198 story requests free-text search over the commercial result.

evidence.summary: The commercial result surface is shared
evidence.detail: The bounded repository surface exposes one query result used by filters, export, and search.
A prior human decision established that export must use the current filtered result.

relationships.title: Export depends on filters
relationships.detail: The export must represent the current filtered result.

relationships.title: Search shares the commercial result
relationships.detail: Filtering and free-text search compose over the same result surface.

relationships.title: Filter controls share one local boundary
relationships.detail: The story, acceptance notes, and screenshot describe one filter capability.

questions.question: Which advanced filters are in scope for US 36134?
questions.why_material: The answer changes the visible filter boundary and acceptance behavior.

questions.question: How should free-text search compose with the filtered result?
questions.why_material: The shared result semantics affect US 36134 and US 36198 together.

reconciliation_attempts.human_response: LIKE matching is required for the first release; the search runs over the filtered result.
remaining_gaps: Accent sensitivity and minimum query length remain undefined.
Accent sensitivity and minimum query length remain undefined.

questions.question: Which result does Excel export represent?
questions.why_material: Export must be consistent with the current filtered result.
questions.answer: Excel export represents the current filtered result at the moment the user exports.
canonical_answer_history: Excel export represents the current filtered result at the moment the user exports.

reconciliation_attempts.human_response: The export should reflect the result after the selected filters are applied.
established_context: Export uses the current filtered result.
reconciliation_attempts.canonical_answer: Excel export represents the current filtered result at the moment the user exports.

findings.title: Advanced filter scope is undefined
findings.problem: The requested advanced filters are not enumerated consistently across the source artifacts.
findings.why_it_matters: The local Requirement cannot be verified without a stable filter boundary.

findings.title: Search and filtering semantics still have a material gap
findings.problem: The first response establishes LIKE matching and composition order but leaves accent handling and minimum query length unresolved.
findings.why_it_matters: Different Requirements could implement different result semantics on the shared surface.
findings.impact: US 36134 and US 36198 remain jointly blocked.

findings.title: Export result semantics were clarified
findings.problem: The exported result previously had no authoritative relationship to the active filter state.
findings.why_it_matters: A stale or unrelated export would mislead users.
findings.impact: The export behavior is now explicit.

resolution.proposal: Export the current filtered result at the moment of export.
resolution.rationale: The human decision closes the result-selection ambiguity and matches the shared surface evidence.

findings.title: Search adapter remains a later technical concern
findings.problem: The observed adapter does not yet expose the final search bounds.
findings.why_it_matters: A technical implementation choice remains after the product decision.
findings.impact: Search follow-up should travel with the downstream work.

final_assessment.rationale: Three logical Requirements share a result surface while retaining distinct source ownership.

handoff.reason: Two open BLOCKING findings remain after one Requirement-specific question was answered and one Cross question received partial information.
